final: WITH per_race AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings WHERE points > 6.0 GROUP BY raceId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS o FROM per_race) SELECT p.raceId, p.avg_points, p.avg_wins, p.avg_wins - o.o AS diff FROM per_race p, overall o WHERE o.o IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
